title: Two Homes-Pickleball-Batting Cage-Sand Volleyball
description:
Welcome to our breathtaking, private escape right in the heart of Scottsdale! In the one-of-a-kind backyard, enjoy the resort-like setting complete with a pool, spa, pickle ball, batting cage, sand volleyball court, basketball court, putting green and more. This massive estate is the perfect retreat for luxurious family gatherings, business retreats, golf trips, bachelor/ette celebrations, or just a relaxing getaway.

 The space 
Located just 18 minutes from the popular shopping and dining destinations of Old Town Scottsdale and Fashion Square Mall and 13 minutes from Kierland Commons. The home itself is two stories, has 8 bedrooms, 5.5 bathrooms, and thoughtful design touches throughout.

Have an extra large group? We own another 7 bedroom house that is just two doors down from this property! Check out the listing here: https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/1135009190625706437?guests=1&adults=1&s=67&unique_share_id=ff532169-8bc9-4638-a5e8-14d6bb029df5

Amenities:
• Resort-Style Backyard Amenities:
o Heated Pool (+$150/night - please request at least one week before arrival)
o Spa (Heated and ready for you at no additional fee)
o Pickle Ball Court
o Batting Cage
o Sand Volleyball Court
o Basketball Court

• Indoor Games:

Neighborhood:
This gorgeous Scottsdale neighborhood is truly one of a kind. We do our absolute best to be fantastic neighbors - they are our friends! We love that we can share our home with our guests and ask that everyone abide by the quiet hours from 10pm-7am so that we can continue to serve our guests without disrupting our great neighborhood.
Getting Around: We enjoy that our home is easily accessible with Ubers or Lyfts for those who do not rent a car or drive in for their family vacation!
Other Things to Note: This home is fully furnished and stocked with a starter amount of essentials to get you going on your trip! Please plan accordingly to purchase enough additional consumables to last for the remainder of your stay. Also, please note there is no central speaker system at the home, so if you'd like music, please plan to bring your own portable speaker.

House Rules and Notes:
• No parties or events of any kind allowed on property
• Must be 25 years of age or older to rent. Renting person must stay in the home throughout the reservation.
• No smoking
• Check-in time is 4 PM (this time is strict)
• Check-out time is 10 AM (this time is strict)
• Early check-in and late check-out (if available fees apply)
• Pets are allowed with exceptions (pet fees apply)
Due To A New City Ordinance:
• All reservations will go through a verification process
• Please be sure your full name is entered on your reservation when booking
• IDs will be requested for verification after booking
• We report and prosecute all credit card fraud

TPT #: 21405841
City Permit #: 2023573

 Guest access 
Our guests have full access to this home during their stay. We only ask that you refrain from removing or tampering with pool equipment to ensure no damage and the pool will remain clean during your stay. The home is keyless entry for a smooth check-in both afternoon and night!

 Other things to note 
Here are a few additional services our guests usually take advantage of along with the rates. Please submit any requests at least 1 week prior to check-in.

1. Early Check-In - $200 (when available & able to confirm 2 weeks prior to arrival)
2. Late Check-Out - $200 (when available & able to confirm 2 weeks prior to arrival)
3. Optional Pool Heating - $150/night *Heated Spa/Jacuzzi is included with your reservation.
4. Optional Daily Housekeeping - $200 for two hours. *Includes bathrooms, beds (sheet and towel change upon advance request), kitchen, and common living spaces. Please submit any special requests in advance.
5. Pet Cleaning and Deodorizing (dogs only) - $125 per pet for the duration of your stay.

In-home Concierge Services:

**Please contact us at least 1 week prior to your stay for any special occasions (birthdays, anniversaries, Bachelor(ette) stays, etc) 

1. Grocery Delivery 
2. Private Chef 
3. Electronics/Consumer Goods 
4. Private In-Home Massage 
5. Baby Equipment Rental 

This property is managed by Sunstone Vacation.
